purpose: Quantify how weak or strong the fixed ATR14 and 180-bar momentum entry-time descriptors distinguish historic MR40 winners vs losers; reduce fruitless future parameter sweeps, NOT a new entry filter.
selection_bias: Features chosen after looking at 47-trade historical medians in earlier phase; outcomes are exploratory, never independent confirmation.

metrics.auc: Mann-Whitney pairwise P(winning_feature > losing_feature) + 0.5 ties; identical definition for both features.
metrics.p: Exact two-sided label-permutation within each frozen cohort, full enumeration of C(25,6)=177100 and C(22,4)=7315 assignments; tie-aware via pairwise AUC count.
metrics.multiplicity: four feature by cohort comparisons; report Bonferroni 4 adjusted p, no optional stopping or feature threshold search.
metrics.direction: Do not reverse sign post hoc to maximize AUC; high feature value means winner as preregistered direction.

decision.pass: No promotion or filters regardless of p. Treat adjusted p as exploratory only due to feature selection on the same seen data.
decision.fail: Never infer no effect solely from nonsignificance; require prospectively unseen episodes.
